purpose: Order 114 hypothesis-1 A/B: test exact current-presentation inspection followed by a parameterized presentation-text-to-Writer operation selected and fully parameterized by the model.
change_scope: Preserve v113 and add presentation.inspect_current plus document.create_from_presentation as generic Multi-Apps facades. Inspection returns the exact active Impress URL and structural content. The model then supplies source_path, output_path, and all options unchanged. Writer extracts selected nonempty slide text, optionally notes and automatic fields, saves DOCX, reopens it, and verifies every paragraph.

protocol.dynamic_instruction_schema_or_stage_forc: conditional generic code-execution guidance only; no schema, action, or argument forcing
protocol.runner_guard_terminal_semantics: Internal guard termination records the reason and invokes the original evaluator without appending OSWorld FAIL; explicit model fail_task remains OSWorld FAIL.
protocol.on_failure: Preserve and audit this hypothesis-1 A/B, classify the new failure, and do not rerun it unchanged. At most two further materially different generic hypotheses remain before marking Order 114 task_blocked and advancing.

implementation_evidence.parent_ab_diagnosis: The untouched v113 model repeatedly guessed a nonexistent presentation.odp path and selected conversion or Writer-file readers that could not inspect the open PPTX. No successful action ran and script.docx was never created.
implementation_evidence.model_argument_policy: Inspection accepts no arguments and returns the exact active presentation identity. Every create argument is copied unchanged from the captured structured model call through the Multi-Apps facade. Runtime code has no task identity, instruction parser, fixed filename, answer, golden, or evaluator access.
implementation_evidence.candidate_bundle_hash_method: SHA-256 of the sorted newline-delimited sha256sum output for the 11 modified production modules listed by this hypothesis.
implementation_evidence.focused_tests: 510 focused tests and the complete 1767-test unit suite passed. Ruff, compileall, project layout, deployment leakage, frozen-v1 SHA256SUMS, and OSWorld commit/evaluator-tree checks passed.
implementation_evidence.counterfactual: Tests use unrelated PPTX/ODP identities, output paths, slide counts, grouped shapes, table text, notes, automatic fields, overwrite options, and fake create-save-reopen state. No Order 114 task ID, filenames, source content, expected output, golden data, or evaluator values are present in runtime code.

selection.method: first targeted generic A/B for Order 114 in the task-ID-deduplicated development coverage ledger
